# ToolHub - Free Online Tools Collection

> 49+ free online tools, all running locally in the browser. No registration, no data upload, open and use.

## Overview

ToolHub (https://www.toolhub.asia) is a pure-frontend online tools website. All calculations and processing happen client-side in the user's browser -- no backend server, no database, no data collection. Every tool is accessible via a dedicated URL and supports dark mode, responsive design, and PWA installation.

## Tool Categories

### Life & Daily Utilities
- **Age Calculator** (age-calculator.html) - Calculate exact age in years, months, and days between two dates. Supports birthdate input with real-time results.
- **BMI Calculator** (bmi-calculator.html) - Body Mass Index calculator with WHO standard categories (underweight/normal/overweight/obese). Supports metric and imperial units.
- **Days Calculator** (days-calculator.html) - Calculate the number of days between two dates, including workdays and weekends breakdown.
- **Currency Converter** (currency-converter.html) - Real-time exchange rate conversion supporting major world currencies.
- **Unit Converter** (unit-converter.html) - Comprehensive unit conversion for length, weight, temperature, area, volume, speed, and more.
- **File Size Converter** (file-size-converter.html) - Convert between bytes, KB, MB, GB, TB with automatic precision.
- **Reading Speed Calculator** (reading-speed-calculator.html) - Estimate reading time for articles based on word count and reading speed.
- **Side Income Calculator** (side-income-calculator.html) - Calculate hourly rates, project quotes, and monthly income targets for freelancers.

### Finance & Investment
- **Mortgage Calculator** (mortgage-calculator.html) - Compare equal principal vs. equal installment repayment methods with amortization schedule.
- **Investment Calculator** (investment-calculator.html) - Compound interest and fixed investment return simulator with growth charts.
- **Savings Interest Calculator** (savings-interest-calculator.html) - Calculate bank deposit maturity returns with various interest calculation methods.

### Developer Tools
- **JSON Formatter** (json-formatter.html) - Format, minify, validate, and beautify JSON data with syntax highlighting and error detection.
- **Base64 Encoder/Decoder** (base64-encoder.html) - Encode/decode Base64 strings and files. Supports text and binary data.
- **URL Encoder/Decoder** (url-encoder-decoder.html) - Percent-encoding and decoding for URLs, with support for Unicode characters.
- **MD5/SHA Hash Generator** (md5-hash.html) - Generate MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-512 hash values for text and files.
- **UUID Generator** (uuid-generator.html) - Generate UUID/GUID v4 identifiers with bulk generation support.
- **Base Converter** (base-converter.html) - Convert between binary, octal, decimal, hexadecimal, and custom bases up to base-36.
- **Timestamp Converter** (timestamp-converter.html) - Convert between Unix timestamps and human-readable dates in multiple formats.
- **JWT Decoder** (jwt-decoder.html) - Decode JWT tokens to view header and payload, with signature verification info.
- **Regex Tester** (regex-tester.html) - Test regular expressions with real-time matching, replacement, and capture group extraction.
- **Cron Expression Generator** (cron-expression-generator.html) - Visual cron schedule builder with human-readable descriptions.
- **HTML Encoder/Decoder** (html-encoder-decoder.html) - Convert between HTML entities and plain text.
- **HTTP Status Code Lookup** (http-status-code-lookup.html) - Search and reference all HTTP status codes with detailed explanations.
- **IP Address Lookup** (ip-address-lookup.html) - IP info and subnet calculator with CIDR notation support.
- **CSS Minifier** (css-minifier.html) - Compress CSS to reduce file size by removing whitespace and comments.
- **JavaScript Minifier** (javascript-minifier.html) - Minify JS code with optional variable name mangling.
- **CSV/JSON Converter** (csv-json-converter.html) - Convert between CSV and JSON formats with custom delimiter support.
- **Naming Convention Converter** (naming-convention-converter.html) - Convert between camelCase, snake_case, PascalCase, kebab-case, and more.
- **Short Link Generator** (short-link-generator.html) - Generate shortened URLs with optional custom aliases.
- **Image to Base64 Converter** (image-to-base64-converter.html) - Convert image files to Base64 data URIs for embedding in CSS/HTML.
- **SVG Preview Tool** (svg-preview-tool.html) - Live preview and edit SVG code with instant visual feedback.

### Text Processing
- **Word Count Tool** (word-count-tool.html) - Count words, characters, lines, and paragraphs in Chinese and English text.
- **Case Converter** (case-converter.html) - Convert text between uppercase, lowercase, title case, and sentence case.
- **Text Deduplicator** (text-deduplicator.html) - Remove duplicate lines and empty lines from text with sorting options.
- **Text Diff Tool** (text-diff-tool.html) - Side-by-side text comparison highlighting additions, deletions, and modifications.
- **Text Formatter** (text-formatter.html) - Clean and format text with options for line breaks, spacing, and indentation.
- **Text Reverser** (text-reverser.html) - Reverse text, words, or lines with multiple reversal modes.
- **List Sorter** (list-sorter.html) - Sort lists alphabetically, numerically, or by length with ascending/descending options.
- **Lorem Ipsum Generator** (lorem-ipsum-generator.html) - Generate placeholder text with customizable length and format.
- **Markdown Editor** (markdown-editor.html) - Live Markdown preview with syntax highlighting and export to HTML.
- **Morse Code Translator** (morse-code-translator.html) - Convert between text and Morse code with audio playback.
- **Char/Byte Counter** (char-byte-counter.html) - Count characters and bytes in UTF-8 encoded text.

### Design & Creative
- **Color Converter** (color-converter.html) - Convert between HEX, RGB, HSL, CMYK, and LAB color formats with color picker.
- **Color Palette Generator** (color-palette-generator.html) - Generate harmonious color palettes from a base color using color theory.
- **CSS Gradient Generator** (css-gradient-generator.html) - Create linear and radial CSS gradients with live preview and code export.
- **QR Code Generator** (qr-code-generator.html) - Generate QR codes for URLs, text, WiFi, and contact info with customization options.
- **Image Compressor** (image-compressor.html) - Compress images (JPG/PNG/WebP) client-side with quality control.

### Security Tools
- **Password Generator** (password-generator.html) - Generate secure random passwords with customizable length and character sets.
- **Password Strength Checker** (password-strength-checker.html) - Evaluate password strength with entropy calculation and improvement suggestions.

### Calculators
- **Scientific Calculator** (scientific-calculator.html) - Full-featured scientific calculator with trigonometric, logarithmic, and statistical functions.
- **Percentage Calculator** (percentage-calculator.html) - Calculate percentage increase/decrease, percentage of a number, and ratio conversions.
- **Random Number Generator** (random-number-generator.html) - Generate random numbers, passwords, and lottery numbers with range customization.

## Technical Features

- **Pure Frontend**: All tools run entirely in the browser using HTML5, CSS3, and vanilla JavaScript
- **Privacy First**: Zero data collection, zero server uploads, zero tracking (except anonymous analytics)
- **Dark Mode**: Full dark theme support with system preference detection
- **Responsive Design**: Optimized for mobile, tablet, and desktop
- **PWA Support**: Installable as a Progressive Web App for offline access
- **Hash Routing**: Every tool accessible via unique URL (e.g., /json-formatter.html)
- **Keyboard Shortcuts**: Common operations supported via keyboard
- **Service Worker**: Offline caching for previously visited tools
- **Structured Data**: Full Schema.org markup (WebApplication, SoftwareApplication, BreadcrumbList)

## Use Cases

When users need:
- Quick calculations without installing apps (mortgage, investment, BMI)
- Developer utilities during coding (JSON formatting, Base64, regex testing, timestamp conversion)
- Text processing for writing or data cleaning (word count, deduplication, diff)
- Design reference (color conversion, gradient generation, QR codes)
- Security tools (password generation, hash verification)
- Unit conversions for travel or cooking
